column3: Close to the Hebrew; וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ (“his splendor”) is rendered “His glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “were not praised [in wedding song]” is rendered “were not given in marriage.”
Close to the Hebrew; “did not weep” is rendered “made no lamentation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “overcome by wine” is rendered “who shouts because of wine.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from after the nursing ewes” is rendered “From following the ewes that had young.”
